featured.title: Haitians face arrest and deportation after US removes TPS protections
featured.summary: DHS secretary Markwayne Mullin says ‘We’re going after them right now’ despite threat of violence in home country Hundreds of thousands of Haitians are faced with the prospect of imminent risk of arrest and deportation – to a home country racked with crime, violence and political unrest – after the Trump administration officially stripped them of humanitarian protections that had allowed them to live and work legally in the United States for years. US district judge Ana Reyes confirmed on Wednesday that her order blocking the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) from ending temporary protected status (TPS) for Haiti was no longer in effect. This followed the controversial supreme court ruling in June that upended judicial review of the program and opened the door for immigration enforcement to track down and detain Haitians en masse. featured.titleZh: 美国取消TPS保护，海地人面临逮捕与驱逐

featured.whyImportant: 此举标志着美国移民政策的进一步收紧，引发了人道主义担忧。

global.title: 熊本地震 死者1人増 災害関連死の疑い1人含め 死者39人に
global.summary: 熊本県は、8日午前7時半の時点で、県内では地震の直接の被害で亡くなった「直接死」かどうか調査している人が1人増えて2人になり、災害関連死の疑いがある1人を含めて39人が死亡したと発表しました。また、県内で開設されている避難所は124か所あり、6591人が避難しているということです。
global.titleZh: 熊本地震死亡人数增至39人，含1例灾害相关死亡疑案
global.summaryZh: 熊本县政府宣布，截至8日上午，地震直接死亡人数调查增加至2人，加上1例疑似灾害相关死亡，总死亡人数达39人。目前县内设有124处避难所，共有6591名民众避难。
global.whyImportant: 此次更新反映了熊本地震灾后伤亡统计的持续修正及当地避难安置的现状。

global.title: Several killed in attacks on Ukraine as Kyiv hits Russian e-commerce giant
global.summary: Ukraine continues to strike warehouses and logistics hubs run by Wildberries, which it says aid Moscow's war efforts.
global.titleZh: 乌克兰袭击俄电商巨头物流中心，造成人员伤亡
global.summaryZh: 乌克兰持续对俄罗斯电商巨头Wildberries的仓库和物流枢纽发动袭击，称其为俄方战争提供支持。袭击导致了人员伤亡。
global.whyImportant: 乌克兰将打击目标扩大至俄罗斯物流基础设施，显示了双方冲突的持续升级。

global.title: Donald Trump renews effort to fire Federal Reserve governor Lisa Cook
global.summary: US president has clashed with Federal Reserve members over his bid to rapidly slash interest rates despite inflation.
global.titleZh: 特朗普再次尝试解雇美联储理事丽莎·库克
global.summaryZh: 美国总统特朗普因在通胀背景下要求快速降息，与美联储成员产生分歧。他目前正重新推动解雇美联储理事丽莎·库克的计划。
global.whyImportant: 此举引发了外界对美联储独立性及美国货币政策未来走向的担忧。

global.title: Prosecutor fired over blogposts critical of Trump sues US justice department
global.summary: Will Rosenzweig’s defunct blog was publicized online by conservative pundit who tagged senior DoJ officials A federal prosecutor fired last year over critical comments he had written as a private citizen about Donald Trump sued the justice department on Friday, saying his termination violated his first amendment rights. Will Rosenzweig was two weeks away from trying a multimillion-dollar Medicare fraud case when a blog he had written years earlier covering a broad range of topics was publicized online by a conservative political commentator who also included a screenshot of Rosenzweig’s LinkedIn account and tagged senior justice department officials for their awareness. Continue reading...
global.titleZh: 因发布批评特朗普博文被解雇，检察官起诉美国司法部
global.summaryZh: 检察官威尔·罗森茨威格因过去作为普通公民发表批评特朗普的博文被解雇，他对此提起诉讼，称其言论自由权受到侵犯。该博文此前被保守派评论员曝光并举报至司法部高层。
global.whyImportant: 该案件凸显了公职人员言论自由与政治立场在当前美国司法环境下的冲突。

global.title: South Koreans beat the heat with ‘silent disco’ pool party
global.summary: South Koreans in Seoul cooled off with a silent disco pool party during a record-breaking heat wave.
global.titleZh: 韩国民众以“静音迪斯科”泳池派对对抗高温
global.summaryZh: 在创纪录的热浪袭击下，韩国首尔民众通过举办“静音迪斯科”泳池派对来消暑降温。
global.whyImportant: 反映了极端天气对民众生活方式的影响及应对措施。

global.title: Lebanon points to ‘positive progress’ on borders, prisoners in Israel talks
global.summary: New Israeli attacks reported in southern Lebanon as Beirut offers optimism after the seventh round of discussions.
global.titleZh: 黎巴嫩称与以色列的边界及囚犯谈判取得“积极进展”
global.summaryZh: 在第七轮谈判后，黎巴嫩方面对边界和囚犯问题表示乐观。与此同时，黎巴嫩南部仍有新的以色列袭击报告。
global.whyImportant: 尽管局势依然紧张，但双方在外交层面的接触显示出寻求缓解冲突的意愿。

global.summary: Barrister alleges ‘account of penis wiggling is an attempt to humiliate’ broadcaster who has pleaded not guilty to 22 charges of indecent assault and sexual touching Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast Alan Jones’s defence barrister has told a Sydney court one of the broadcaster’s alleged victims invented details of alleged indecent assaults at a Fitzroy Falls farm to “humiliate” and “smear” the former media titan. Complainant J told the court during evidence-in-chief earlier this week that during one alleged incident in the property’s bedroom, Jones’s penis was not fully erect and “not very big”. Continue reading...
global.titleZh: 艾伦·琼斯案：辩方称原告通过披露私密细节意在羞辱被告
global.summaryZh: 广播员艾伦·琼斯面临22项猥亵指控，他对此表示不认罪。辩方律师指责原告在法庭上描述的细节是为了羞辱和抹黑被告。
global.whyImportant: 该案件因涉及知名公众人物及敏感指控，在澳大利亚社会引发广泛关注。

global.title: 「ロシアがNATO限定侵攻の可能性も」 米情報機関が分析か
global.summary: アメリカの有力紙は、ロシアが数年以内にNATO＝北大西洋条約機構の加盟国に限定的な地上侵攻を仕掛ける可能性があると、アメリカの情報機関が分析していると伝えました。
global.titleZh: 美情报机构分析称俄罗斯可能对北约发动有限入侵
global.summaryZh: 据美国媒体报道，美国情报机构分析认为，俄罗斯可能在未来几年内对北约成员国发动有限的地面入侵。
global.whyImportant: 此分析加剧了北约成员国对地区安全局势的担忧。

global.title: What could the Mecca defence pact mean for the US role in the Middle East?
global.summary: Analysts say regional partners are seeking alternatives to supplement their security without discarding US support.
global.titleZh: 麦加防务协议对美国在中东的角色意味着什么？
global.summaryZh: 分析人士指出，中东地区伙伴正在寻求补充安全保障的替代方案，而非完全放弃美国的支持。该协议反映了地区国家在安全战略上的多元化尝试。
global.whyImportant: 这标志着中东地区安全架构正在发生微妙的调整，可能影响美国在该地区的影响力。

global.title: Trump shifts blame to Republicans for waning support from public
global.summary: Republican senators are using the summer recess to avoid politically difficult votes.
global.titleZh: 特朗普将公众支持率下降归咎于共和党人
global.summaryZh: 特朗普指责共和党人导致其公众支持率下滑。目前共和党参议员正利用夏季休会期，以避免参与政治敏感的投票。
global.whyImportant: 显示了特朗普与共和党内部在政治策略上的分歧。

china.title: China faces new AI bottleneck as it runs out of Chinese-language training data
china.summary: China’s high-stakes race to build next-generation artificial intelligence models is entering a critical new phase, where a less visible yet far more existential threat is coming into view: a severe shortage of high-quality training data. While the US chokehold on advanced computing chips has dominated headlines, Chinese AI experts increasingly warn that running out of quality data could prove to be the next major bottleneck to the nation’s tech ambitions – and one that hardware workarounds...
china.titleZh: 中国AI面临新瓶颈：中文训练数据告急
china.summaryZh: 中国在人工智能领域的竞争正进入关键阶段，但高质量中文训练数据的严重短缺成为主要瓶颈。专家警告，这可能比芯片限制对技术发展产生更深远的影响。
china.whyImportant: 数据资源短缺已成为制约中国AI产业发展的核心挑战。

china.title: HKU virologist spared conviction for assaulting man and damaging his phone
china.summary: A University of Hong Kong (HKU) virologist has been spared a criminal conviction for assaulting a man and damaging his mobile phone at a railway station last year. Eastern Court on Friday placed Vijaykrishna Dhanasekaran on a two-year bind-over order and instructed him to pay HK$800 (US$102) in damages, after he admitted attacking a stranger at Hong Kong MTR station on August 17, 2025. The 48-year-old associate professor, who heads the university’s pathogen evolution lab, could be fined HK$2,000...
china.titleZh: 港大病毒学家袭击他人及损坏手机案获免除定罪
china.summaryZh: 香港大学病毒学家Vijaykrishna Dhanasekaran因去年在地铁站袭击他人并损坏手机，被法院判处两年守行为，并需支付赔偿金。他此前已承认相关指控。
china.whyImportant: 该判决引发了关于学术界人士行为准则及法律处理的讨论。

china.title: CUHK chief calls for more funds for campuses in Northern Metropolis university town
china.summary: The leader of the Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK) has called for greater financial support to develop a proposed 300-hectare (741 acres) university town near the border with mainland China, including funding for local institutions to build campuses, arguing that expansion will help navigate future challenges. In a wide-ranging interview with the South China Morning Post, CUHK president Dennis Lo Yuk-ming said Hong Kong universities needed to expand their presence in the Northern...
china.titleZh: 中大校长呼吁为北部都会区大学城提供更多资金
china.summaryZh: 香港中文大学校长卢煜明呼吁政府加大财政支持，以开发靠近内地边境的300公顷大学城。他认为扩大校园规模有助于应对未来的挑战。
china.whyImportant: 此举旨在推动香港高等教育与北部都会区发展的深度融合。

china.title: Endanger Hong Kong’s national security and I’ll take you down, Chris Tang warns
china.summary: Hong Kong’s security chief has warned he will take down anyone who endangers national security, while also slamming an embattled press group for lacking credibility ahead of an already delayed leadership election. Secretary for Security Chris Tang Ping-keung said on Friday that the Hong Kong Journalists Association (HKJA) was “not a statutory organisation” and that candidates for its executive committee reportedly included no representatives from mainstream local media outlets, undermining its...
china.titleZh: 邓炳强警告：危害国家安全者必将受到打击
china.summaryZh: 香港保安局局长邓炳强警告称，将打击任何危害国家安全的人。同时，他批评香港记者协会缺乏公信力，并指出其执委会候选人缺乏主流媒体代表。
china.whyImportant: 反映了香港政府对国家安全及相关社会组织监管的强硬立场。

china.title: Typhoon Dolphin: Hongkongers stuck in Okinawa prepare for low supplies, power cuts
china.summary: Hong Kong holidaymakers in Okinawa on Friday contended with depleted supermarket shelves, potential power cuts and violent weather as Typhoon Dolphin shut the Japanese island’s main airport and disrupted every direct flight home. Social media images shared by Hong Kong-linked travel accounts showed empty bread shelves and torrential rain sweeping parts of the popular destination, although travellers said conditions varied significantly across the island. Hong Kong travel account Papa Traveller...
china.titleZh: 台风“海豚”袭冲绳，滞留港人面临物资短缺与停电风险
china.summaryZh: 受台风“海豚”影响，冲绳机场关闭，所有直飞航班中断。滞留当地的香港游客面临超市货架空空如也及潜在的停电风险。
china.whyImportant: 台风对当地旅游业及滞留游客的安全保障造成了严重影响。

watch.titleZh: 休达边境争端：西班牙对来自意大利的旅客实施边境管制
watch.summaryZh: 由于意大利未停止相关管制措施，西班牙宣布对来自意大利的旅客实施入境检查。尽管两国并无陆地边界，但此次争端源于休达边境事件。
